description: This file defines a modules client for a dashboard frontend, providing functions to fetch module overviews and metrics from a backend API, including URL resolution, data fetching, and data normalization.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL using environment variables, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with error handling and optional credentials.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Normalizes various data shapes into an array.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches a modules overview for the dashboard, trying multiple endpoints or deriving minimal data.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated totals for the overview screen, including total users and deployed apps.
